brief:
Iran's foreign ministry warned Tuesday that Israel's presence in the region was creating a "dangerous situation," the Middle East Eye reported. The statement came after Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu visited the United Arab Emirates.

Iran has long opposed deepening Israeli-Emirati ties and viewed such visits as threats to regional stability. The foreign ministry's condemnation reflects Tehran's broader resistance to normalization agreements between Israel and Gulf states.

title: Iran condemns Netanyahu's UAE visit as destabilizing regional presence
